import Std

/-! Executable ordinary rooted-MAF model and a finite-search correctness core.
No faster branching algorithm is asserted. See FORMAL.md for semantic scope. -/

namespace RMAF

inductive Tree where
  | leaf : Nat → Tree
  | node : Tree → Tree → Tree
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def leaves : Tree → List Nat
  | .leaf x => [x]
  | .node l r => leaves l ++ leaves r

/-- Binary shape is built into Tree; these hypotheses make labelling bijective
and ensure that the input trees have the identical canonical taxon set. -/
structure Instance where
  n : Nat
  left : Tree
  right : Tree
  labels_left : (leaves left).Perm (List.range n)
  labels_right : (leaves right).Perm (List.range n)

/-- Inductive rooted label-preserving isomorphism, independent of the Boolean
checker. No orientation of siblings is part of a phylogenetic tree. -/
inductive RootedIso : Tree → Tree → Prop where
  | leaf (x : Nat) : RootedIso (.leaf x) (.leaf x)
  | straight {a b c d : Tree} : RootedIso a c → RootedIso b d →
      RootedIso (.node a b) (.node c d)
  | swapped {a b c d : Tree} : RootedIso a d → RootedIso b c →
      RootedIso (.node a b) (.node c d)

/-- A labelled rooted isomorphism may swap the children at any vertex. -/
def sameShape : Tree → Tree → Bool
  | .leaf a, .leaf b => a == b
  | .node a b, .node c d =>
      (sameShape a c && sameShape b d) ||
      (sameShape a d && sameShape b c)
  | _, _ => false

def restrict (selected : List Nat) : Tree → Option Tree
  | .leaf x => if selected.contains x then some (.leaf x) else none
  | .node l r =>
      match restrict selected l, restrict selected r with
      | none, none => none
      | some a, none => some a
      | none, some b => some b
      | some a, some b => some (.node a b)

abbrev Vertex := List Bool

def prependSide (side : Bool) (vs : List Vertex) : List Vertex :=
  vs.map (side :: ·)

/-- The rooted span includes paths from this root to every selected leaf.
Unary path vertices must be retained for embedding-disjointness checks. -/
def rootedSpan (selected : List Nat) : Tree → List Vertex
  | .leaf x => if selected.contains x then [[]] else []
  | .node l r =>
      let ls := rootedSpan selected l
      let rs := rootedSpan selected r
      if ls.isEmpty && rs.isEmpty then []
      else [] :: (prependSide false ls ++ prependSide true rs)

/-- The minimal embedding starts at the selected leaves' LCA, not the input root.
Once both children contribute, keep all intervening unary path vertices. -/
def minimalVertices (selected : List Nat) : Tree → List Vertex
  | .leaf x => if selected.contains x then [[]] else []
  | .node l r =>
      let ls := rootedSpan selected l
      let rs := rootedSpan selected r
      if ls.isEmpty then prependSide true (minimalVertices selected r)
      else if rs.isEmpty then prependSide false (minimalVertices selected l)
      else [] :: (prependSide false ls ++ prependSide true rs)

def disjointVertices (a b : List Vertex) : Bool :=
  a.all (fun v => !(b.contains v))

def pairwiseEmbeddings (t : Tree) : List (List Nat) → Bool
  | [] => true
  | b :: bs =>
      bs.all (fun c => disjointVertices (minimalVertices b t) (minimalVertices c t)) &&
      pairwiseEmbeddings t bs

def restrictionAgrees (t u : Tree) (b : List Nat) : Bool :=
  match restrict b t, restrict b u with
  | some s, some v => sameShape s v
  | _, _ => false

def partitionCheck (labels : List Nat) (bs : List (List Nat)) : Bool :=
  bs.all (fun b => !b.isEmpty) &&
  labels.all (fun x => bs.flatten.count x == 1) &&
  bs.flatten.all (fun x => labels.contains x)

def agreement (t u : Tree) (bs : List (List Nat)) : Bool :=
  partitionCheck (leaves t) bs && partitionCheck (leaves u) bs &&
  bs.all (restrictionAgrees t u) &&
  pairwiseEmbeddings t bs && pairwiseEmbeddings u bs

/-- Every assignment has one entry per leaf; tag equality defines its block.

import StatePartition

/-! Problem-local literal finite forest states. No desired reduction fields. -/
namespace ForestState
open RMAF RestrictionBridge

def labels : Option Tree → List Nat
  | none => []
  | some t => leaves t

def targetEmbeddings : Option Tree → List (List Nat) → Bool
  | none, F => F.isEmpty
  | some t, F => pairwiseEmbeddings t F

def targetAgrees : Option Tree → Tree → List Nat → Bool
  | none, _, _ => false
  | some t, s, B => restrictionAgrees t s B

def proper (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) : Bool :=
  decide (labels T).Nodup && partitionCheck (labels T) (ss.map leaves)

def sourceCheck (T : Option Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) (s : Tree) : Bool :=
  let G := family (leaves s) F
  partitionCheck (leaves s) G && G.all (targetAgrees T s) && pairwiseEmbeddings s G

def agrees (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) : Bool :=
  proper T ss && partitionCheck (labels T) F &&
  F.all (fun B => ss.any (fun s => contained B (leaves s))) &&
  targetEmbeddings T F && ss.all (sourceCheck T F)

def additionalCost (ss : List Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) := F.length - ss.length

import CoreGraph

/-! One-shot candidate implementation of the pinned source generator.
No optimum/partition-enumeration oracle is called. This module is executable
and budget-total; graph coverage and original-cut realization remain separate
proof obligations. All original addresses survive suppression. -/
namespace Universal233.CoreProgram
open RMAF

structure Group where
  origin : Vertex
  labels : List Nat
  color : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive GTree where
  | leaf : Group → GTree
  | node : Vertex → GTree → GTree → GTree
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def fromTree (color : Nat → Nat) (p : Vertex) : Tree → GTree
  | .leaf x => .leaf ⟨p, [x], color x⟩
  | .node l r => .node p (fromTree color (p ++ [false]) l) (fromTree color (p ++ [true]) r)

def groups : GTree → List Group
  | .leaf g => [g]
  | .node _ l r => groups l ++ groups r

def normalize : GTree → GTree
  | .leaf g => .leaf g
  | .node p l r =>
      match normalize l, normalize r with
      | .leaf a, .leaf b =>
          if a.color = b.color then .leaf ⟨p, a.labels ++ b.labels, a.color⟩
          else .node p (.leaf a) (.leaf b)
      | a, b => .node p a b

def erase (chosen : Vertex) : GTree → Option GTree
  | .leaf g => if g.origin = chosen then none else some (.leaf g)
  | .node p l r =>
      if p = chosen then none else
      match erase chosen l, erase chosen r with
      | none, none => none
      | some a, none => some a
      | none, some b => some b
      | some a, some b => some (.node p a b)

def mixedCherry : GTree → Option (Group × Group)
  | .leaf _ => none
  | .node _ (.leaf a) (.leaf b) => some (a, b)
  | .node _ l r => (mixedCherry l).or (mixedCherry r)

inductive Choice where
  | finish
  | one : Group → Choice
  | two : Group → Group → Choice
  | refuse : String → Choice
  deriving Repr

def choose (t : GTree) : Choice :=
  let gs := groups t
  match gs with
  | [] => .refuse "empty current source"
  | first :: _ =>
      if gs.all (fun g => g.color == first.color) then .finish
      else
        match gs.find? (fun g => (gs.filter (fun h => h.color == g.color)).length == 1) with
        | some g => .one g
        | none =>
            match mixedCherry t with
            | some (a, b) =>
                if a.color == b.color then .refuse "unnormalized homogeneous cherry"
                else .two a b
            | none => .refuse "no mixed cherry in multicolor source"

structure Output where
  partition : List (List Nat)
  /-- An address records the actual original edge (dropLast address,address).
  The original root address [] is forbidden by the generator. -/
  sourceCuts : List Vertex
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Receipt where
  outputs : List Output := []
  refusals : List String := []
  visited : Nat := 0
  childAttempts : Nat := 0
  pruned : Nat := 0
  deriving Repr

def combine (a b : Receipt) : Receipt :=
  ⟨a.outputs ++ b.outputs, a.refusals ++ b.refusals,
    a.visited + b.visited, a.childAttempts + b.childAttempts, a.pruned + b.pruned⟩

def prefixRoot (r : Receipt) : Receipt := { r with visited := r.visited + 1 }

def attempt (continuation : GTree → List Group → List Vertex → Receipt)
    (t : GTree) (detached : List Group) (cuts : List Vertex) (g : Group) : Receipt :=
  if g.origin = [] then ⟨[], ["attempt to cut original root"], 0, 1, 0⟩
  else if cuts.contains g.origin then ⟨[], ["duplicate original source cut"], 0, 1, 0⟩
  else
    match erase g.origin t with
    | none => ⟨[], ["attempt removed entire current source"], 0, 1, 0⟩
    | some next =>
        let r := continuation next (g :: detached) (g.origin :: cuts)
        { r with childAttempts := r.childAttempts + 1 }

def step (continuation : GTree → List Group → List Vertex → Receipt)
    (current : GTree) (detached : List Group) (cuts : List Vertex) : Receipt :=
  let t := normalize current
  match choose t with
  | .finish => ⟨[⟨detached.map Group.labels ++ [(groups t).flatMap Group.labels], cuts⟩], [], 1, 0, 0⟩
  | .one g => prefixRoot (attempt continuation t detached cuts g)
  | .two a b => prefixRoot (combine (attempt continuation t detached cuts a)
      (attempt continuation t detached cuts b))
  | .refuse why => ⟨[], [why], 1, 0, 0⟩

/-- Budget counts original source cuts. Every over-budget attempted child is
retained as a pruned prefix and included in childAttempts. -/
def run : Nat → GTree → List Group → List Vertex → Receipt
  | 0 => step (fun _ _ _ => ⟨[], [], 0, 0, 1⟩)
  | q + 1 => step (run q)

def generate (t : Tree) (color : Nat → Nat) (budget : Nat) : Receipt :=
  if (leaves t).Nodup then run (min budget ((leaves t).length - 1)) (fromTree color [] t) [] []
  else ⟨[], ["duplicate original label"], 0, 0, 0⟩

namespace VertexGeometry
abbrev Vertex := List Bool

/-- The unique path in the infinite binary address tree, with endpoints kept.
Its restriction to a prefix-closed finite binary tree is its actual graph path. -/
inductive PathAt : Vertex → Vertex → Vertex → Prop where
  | endpointL (a b : Vertex) : PathAt a a b
  | endpointR (a b : Vertex) : PathAt b a b
  | fork (a b : Vertex) : PathAt [] (false :: a) (true :: b)
  | fork' (a b : Vertex) : PathAt [] (true :: a) (false :: b)
  | down (s : Bool) {v a b : Vertex} : PathAt v a b → PathAt (s :: v) (s :: a) (s :: b)
  | leftLeg (s : Bool) {v a : Vertex} : PathAt v a [] → PathAt (s :: v) (s :: a) []
  | rightLeg (s : Bool) {v b : Vertex} : PathAt v [] b → PathAt (s :: v) [] (s :: b)
  | crossLeft (s : Bool) {v a b : Vertex} : PathAt v a [] →
      PathAt (s :: v) (s :: a) ((!s) :: b)
  | crossRight (s : Bool) {v a b : Vertex} : PathAt v [] b →
      PathAt (s :: v) ((!s) :: a) (s :: b)

/-- Leaf-address hull, including singleton leaf hulls. -/
def Hull (S : Vertex → Prop) (v : Vertex) : Prop :=
  ∃ a b, S a ∧ S b ∧ PathAt v a b

def Prefix (p a : Vertex) : Prop := ∃ q, a = p ++ q

def ProperPrefix (p a : Vertex) : Prop := ∃ s q, a = p ++ s :: q

/-- Removing a nonlabelled target gives the parent direction and two child
regions. The value 3 is the removed vertex itself, never a label in our use. -/
def region : Vertex → Vertex → Nat
  | [], [] => 3
  | [], false :: _ => 0
  | [], true :: _ => 1
  | _ :: _, [] => 2
  | s :: v, t :: a => if s = t then region v a else 2

/-- At two surviving vertices, equality means membership in the same actual
component after deleting the target. -/
def SameRegion (v a b : Vertex) : Prop := region v a = region v b

def leafList (D : List Nat) : RMAF.Tree → List Vertex
  | .leaf x => if D.contains x then [[]] else []
  | .node l r => RMAF.prependSide false (leafList D l) ++
      RMAF.prependSide true (leafList D r)

def regions (D : List Nat) (t : RMAF.Tree) (v : Vertex) : List Nat :=
  [0,1,2].filter (fun c => (leafList D t).any (fun a => region v a == c))

def vertices : RMAF.Tree → List Vertex
  | .leaf _ => [[]]
  | .node l r => [] :: (RMAF.prependSide false (vertices l) ++ RMAF.prependSide true (vertices r))

def edges : RMAF.Tree → List (Vertex × Vertex)
  | .leaf _ => []
  | .node l r => ([],[false]) :: ([],[true]) ::
      ((edges l).map (fun e => (false::e.1,false::e.2)) ++
       (edges r).map (fun e => (true::e.1,true::e.2)))

def prefixB : Vertex → Vertex → Bool
  | [], _ => true
  | _::_, [] => false
  | s::p,t::a => (s==t) && prefixB p a

inductive Choice where
  | vertex : Vertex → Choice
  | edge : (Vertex × Vertex) → Choice
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def properInput (t : RMAF.Tree) (A B : List Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (RMAF.leaves t).Nodup && decide A.Nodup && decide B.Nodup &&
  !A.isEmpty && !B.isEmpty &&
  A.all (fun x => (RMAF.leaves t).contains x) &&
  B.all (fun x => (RMAF.leaves t).contains x) && A.all (fun x => !(B.contains x))

def vertexOK (t : RMAF.Tree) (A B : List Nat) (v : Vertex) : Bool :=
  (RMAF.minimalVertices A t).contains v && (RMAF.minimalVertices B t).contains v &&
    ((regions A t v).length==3 || (regions B t v).length==3)

def edgeOK (t : RMAF.Tree) (A B : List Nat) (e : Vertex × Vertex) : Bool :=
  (RMAF.minimalVertices A t).contains e.1 && (RMAF.minimalVertices B t).contains e.1 &&
  (RMAF.minimalVertices A t).contains e.2 && (RMAF.minimalVertices B t).contains e.2 &&
  [false,true].all (fun inside =>
    !(sideLabels A t e.2 inside).isEmpty && !(sideLabels B t e.2 inside).isEmpty &&
    RMAF.disjointVertices (RMAF.minimalVertices (sideLabels A t e.2 inside) t) (RMAF.minimalVertices B t) &&
    RMAF.disjointVertices (RMAF.minimalVertices (sideLabels B t e.2 inside) t) (RMAF.minimalVertices A t))

def choose (t : RMAF.Tree) (A B : List Nat) : Option Choice :=
  if properInput t A B then
    match (vertices t).find? (vertexOK t A B) with
    | some v => some (.vertex v)
    | none => ((edges t).find? (edgeOK t A B)).map Choice.edge
  else none

def wholeOutputs (S : Tree) (A B : List Nat) (ca cb cc : Nat → Nat) (q : Nat) : List Output :=
  (generate S (taggedColor A B ca cb cc) q).outputs
